(knob 1 = the first CC).

role.description: The port's role in its model (see `MidiDevice::role`).

NoteBinding.description: Route notes from a device into an instrument.

channel.description: MIDI channel 1-16; any channel if absent.

low.description: Lowest and highest input note (inclusive); all notes if absent.

remap.description:
Output note for input notes `low`, `low + 1`, ... (from 0 without
`low`), e.g. pads to drum voices. Overrides `transpose`; a note past
the list plays nothing.

target.description:
An instrument id, `focus` for the seat's focused instrument, or
`@<type>` for the first instrument of a type (`@tr808`).
Alternatives separated by `|` are tried in order: `@tb303|focus`.

NoteStep.description: One step of a note pattern. `note` is a MIDI number; `None` is a rest.

slide.description: Glide into the next step's note without retriggering.

OutputInfo.description: One routable output of an instrument.

oneOf.description: Always `MAX_STEPS` long.

Placement.description:
A clip placed on the song timeline. It plays from `offset` ticks into
the clip, looping at the clip's length, for `length` ticks.

path.description: Engine-side path of the project bundle, if saved/loaded.

RecordMode.description: How a recording pass treats the notes already in the clip.

oneOf.description: Add to what is there.
Each pass clears the part of the loop it passes over.

RecordState.description:
Recording (RFC 0008): whether a take is running, and the settings the
next one uses.

count_in.description: Bars of metronome before recording from a stop.

instrument.description: The instrument being recorded into, while recording.

offset_ms.description: Extra input latency compensated, in milliseconds.

quantize.description: Record quantize grid in ticks; `None` keeps the played timing.

recording.description: A take is running (the transport plays and notes are recorded).

strength.description: 0..1: how far notes move toward the grid.

user.description: Who started the take (whose undo history it lands in).

defaults.description:
Devices on this engine that play here with their model's default
layout (no bindings of the seat's own), as `device (Model)`.

learning.description:
Parameter that the next CC moved on this seat's devices will be
mapped to (`seat.learn_cc`).

occupants.description: Client ids (`name#n`) sitting in this seat.

saved.description: Saved with the project. A seat made with "ignore" is not.

SeatConfig.description: One performer's setup: saved in the project.

focus.description:
Instrument that `focus` bindings, the Block, and following knobs
play. The first instrument if absent.

knob_page.description:
Knob page id; the focused instrument's first page if absent or not
one of its pages.

pitch_bend.description:
Where pitch bend goes: `focus`, an instrument id, or `@<type>`.
Default: the focus.

SeatsState.description: Every seat, and which one the engine host's own devices use.

host.description: Seat of the MIDI devices attached to the engine host.

TrackInfo.description:
An instrument's track: its clip pool, the selected clip, and its
arrangement (placements sorted by start, not overlapping).

TrackPattern.description:
Steps for one track. Each entry is 0 (off), 1 (on), or 2 (accent).
Always `MAX_STEPS` long; `sequencer.length` sets how many are played.

start.description: Song tick song mode plays from (`transport.locate`).

tick.description: Song tick playing (song mode), while playing.

Voice.description: The eight TR-808-style drum voices. Order is the track order.

snapshot.description: Full engine state. Subscribers apply events with `seq` greater than this.

patterns.description: One step view per instrument, in instrument order.

tracks.description: Each instrument's track (RFC 0008): pool, selection, arrangement.

snapshot.title: Snapshot
